name: jo-company-formation
description: Jordan company formation and entity choice for 2026, using official company-law extracts for LLC partners, minimum capital, capital-payment timing, registration documents and annual accounts, and the private-shareholding capital floor. Distinguishes company registration from activity/foreign-investment permission, tax registration and social-security onboarding. Preserves the earlier foreign capital, incorporation timeline, registration-renewal and compliance topics as explicit holds where current operative authority or live procedure remains unconfirmed. Produces formation working papers for professional review, not an automatic licence, tax exemption or completed incorporation.
